title: Kidou Senshi Z Gundam: Zenpen Zeta no Kodou
native_title: 機動戦士Ｚガンダム ～前編 ゼータの鼓動～
overview:
The next story after the original Mobile Suit Gundam arrives just as it played out on TV. This first volume follows episodes 1 to 26 of the Mobile Suit Z Gundam anime and the young pilot Kamille Bidan, told through anime scenes between the battles.

Pilot the Gundam Mk-II in a stage-based shooting game that builds on the system of the earlier Saturn Mobile Suit Gundam. Lock on to enemies and fight through ten stages - from The Black Gundam and Escape from Side One to Entering the Atmosphere, The Winds of Jaburo and Hong Kong City - each ending in a clash with a boss mobile suit.

- Mobile suits that fully transform
- Memory backup support
